title: Media Intelligence
subtitle: One correlated view of every title: what is known, what is missing, and why.
advisory: Observational only. Media Intelligence reports what it finds and never downloads, deletes, moves or repairs anything.

attention.subtitle: What needs a person, why, and what you can do about it.
attention.advisory: Acknowledging, snoozing or dismissing records your decision. None of it changes what is actually true about the media.

policies.title: Lifecycle Policies
policies.subtitle: What you want UltraTorrent to maintain. Policies explain and recommend — they never act on their own.
policies.empty: No lifecycle policies yet. Nothing is being maintained, which is the honest default.
policies.emptyHint: A policy states what you want kept true. UltraTorrent compares it to what is actually true and explains the difference.
policies.name: Name
policies.scopeNone: Nothing of this kind exists yet.
policies.modeHelp: Neither mode acts on its own. Automatic maintenance does not exist yet.

quality.label: Quality
quality.help: Judged against your existing Auto-Download preference ladder. This does not create a second quality setting.
quality.maintain_acceptable: Any rung I configured is fine
quality.maintain_preferred: Keep it at my preferred rung

completeness.label: Completeness
completeness.help: Uses the same aired / unaired / ignored classification as Missing Episodes.

subtitles.label: Required subtitle languages
subtitles.help: Comma-separated. Leave blank to say nothing; an empty saved list means explicitly none.
subtitles.caveat: UltraTorrent can confirm a language is present, but cannot prove one is absent — embedded tracks are not catalogued and subtitle scans are not recorded. A missing language reports as unknown, never as a violation.

policies.conflict: Two equally specific policies disagree about {{dimension}}. Resolve it by changing one of them.
policies.previewIntro: A simulation against current media. Nothing is saved and nothing is acted on.
policies.previewTruncated: Showing the first {{count}} entities in scope — the scope is larger than that.
policies.previewEmpty: Nothing in scope to evaluate yet.
policies.reevaluating: Re-evaluating your library in the background.

drift.subtitle: What your policies ask for, and how this title compares.
drift.none: No lifecycle policy covers this title.
drift.noneHint: Without a policy there is nothing to compare against — this is not the same as the title being correct.
